The vagaries of fashion are many, but there are none that surpass this for the unusual. Down in the Azorcs, it is the National costume and as Dime Fashion is always importing and changing her creations, there would be no great surprise if some fair maiden would meander down Fifth Avenue costumed in this outfit. The attire has a suggestion of the ancient Monk's costumes. The Cardinal cap with the extremely large hood, well nigh near large enough to cover some of the smaller automobiles. Kopp your eyes open, and the first time you see one of the gentler sex promenading on the main thoroughfare of your city or town in this habiliment, remember that we told you so.

CAOT COURTNEY'S ARRIVAL AT AZORES.
Capt Courtney's 'plane photographed just after
the arrival at Horta, Fayal, Azores.

ITEM-According to latest despatches the Nancei seaplanes are one hundred miles from the Corvo Islands in the Azores.Corva is three hundred miles west of Ponta Delgada and completes more than half the trip across the Atlantic Ocean.Supply boats are stationed there and also at Horta on the south east coast of the Island of Fjayal where this photo was taken.Intense interest in the flight is manifested there and hundreds of persons crowd the waterfront dilt awaiting the fliers. The upper photo shows the beautiful avenue of Ribeirinna at Fjayal while the lower shows the inhabitants all dressed in their holiday best promising about the Flamingoe Bridge.
5/17/19.
